title: 788. Domino and Tromino Tiling

examples.explanation: Two vertical or two horizontal dominoes.

hints: Let dp[n] be the number of full tilings of width n; consider how the rightmost column can be closed.
A recurrence dp[n] = 2*dp[n-1] + dp[n-3] captures domino and tromino completions.
Seed dp[0]=1, dp[1]=1, dp[2]=2 and apply the modulus at every step.
